First performs 8 dependent all-reduces within each node subset, then a final cross-node aggregation. Total ~9-16 dispatches depending on hierarchy depth, but each operates on smaller communicator groups, potentially reducing per-dispatch latency.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Pipeline
strategies.desc: Replaces each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter (producing 1/W-th partial sums per rank) followed by all-gather to reconstruct full result. For 8 dependent stages, this gives 16 total dispatches but reduces payload per operation from 16*2048 to ~16*2048/224 in the reduce-scatter phase. Trades dispatch count increase for bandwidth savings in the scatter phase.

strategies.name: Precomputed Coverage Tensor Broadcast
strategies.desc:
One rank computes the global per-block coverage count vector c[16] (identical across all ranks given deterministic windows), broadcasts it once, then performs 8 all-reduces on dynamically masked blocks with a final element-wise division by broadcasted counts. Requires 9 dispatches (1 broadcast + 8 all-reduce) but eliminates redundant per-rank coverage computation and amortizes normalization to the end.
